title: cost-optimization: autotune batching/caching defaults + quant profiles + unit-econ tooling
author: Aisha Patel
description:
This PR implements an end-to-end cost-optimization automation stack: (1) autotuneable defaults for batching and prefix/KV caching, (2) quantization profile selector with safety heuristics, and (3) unit-economics tooling to surface recommended configs in the Console and CLI. Motivation: customers running sustained inference workloads need predictable unit cost improvements without manual tuning. This change automates conservative defaults, provides signals for safe quantization, and exposes per-route unit-econ suggestions so engineers can adopt savings with confidence. Scope: runtime autotuner (controller + policy), model metadata changes (quant profiles), console/CLI UX and telemetry (+server-side endpoint), and tests/benchmarks. Checklist:
- [x] Runtime: implement autotune controller and batching/caching default policy
- [x] Runtime: KV cache sizing and prefix-caching heuristics
- [x] Model registry: add quantization profile metadata and compatibility matrix
- [x] Console: unit-econ suggestions UI and export CLI command
- [x] Telemetry: per-route cost/latency breakdown and autotune recommendation events
- [x] Integration tests and CI benchmarks
- [x] Docs & release notes
Notes on safety: quantization profile selector defers to verified profiles for model families in registry; an automatic rollback policy is included for quality regressions captured by existing eval jobs. Related: ENG-5241 (autotune controller), ENG-5290 (unit-econ UX).

review_comments: Jason Liu: Nice work — high level looks good. Can you add more details on how cache sizing adapts for mixed sequence lengths?

Author (Aisha Patel): The policy uses a sliding-window distribution estimator (see runtime/autotune/policy.go) and caps cache growth under 70% GPU memory pressure. Added comments and unit tests for mixed seq lengths.
Priya Menon: Quant profiles are sensitive. Did you include an opt-out / manual pin for customers?

Author (Aisha Patel): Yes — model-registry includes an explicit 'force_pin' flag per model version, and the console surfaces a one-click pin to revert to a baseline profile. Also added auto-rollback on any eval regression above threshold.
Ethan Kim: Integration test flaked in CI initially (benchmarks timed out). Can we make the benchmark job less noisy?
Author (Aisha Patel): Increased timeouts and moved the heavy integration bench to a nightly pipeline. CI pipeline updated: cost-opt-benchmark.yml; ad-hoc runs remain available.
Jason Liu: Left a minor lint nits in console component. Fixed and ran lint again.
release_notes: Automated cost-optimization: autotune defaults for batching and KV/prefix caching; quantization profile selector with safety heuristics and rollback; Console and CLI unit-economics recommendations to help teams adopt cost-saving configs.
